thread:
maria: Heads up — after last night's driver push to 534.67 we're seeing ~30% NCCL allreduce retry rate on H100 pools in eu-west-2. Logs show PTX kernel signature mismatches for SM90 flows. Canary alerts firing.

alex: :eyes: can you paste the log snippet and which node pools are affected?

maria: here's the most common log fragment from the failing pods (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-18T02:12:45Z] nvptx: kernel_signature_mismatch: kernel_id=0x3a2c pt=sm90 expected_sig=0x1f44 got_sig=0x1f46
NCCL_WARNING: allreduce retry (id=8592) rank=3 -> retry_count=5
```

ravi: Are both managed hopper pools and our dedicated H100s affected, or just the managed ones?

maria: Only the hopper-managed H100 instance groups in eu-west-2 (two AZs) so far. Dedicated reserved capacity in us-west and asia are clean. Looks like the driver enforces a newer PTX signature that our runtime's JIT is producing for some kernels.

jeff: Can we roll back the driver on the affected nodes quickly? What's the rollback playbook?

maria: Plan: cordon+drain affected nodes, restart with previous driver 533.99, verify NCCL success, then uncordon. Quick commands:
```
# cordon + drain node
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# update driver image (example for GCE container-based driver manager)
gcloud compute instances update-container <node-instance> --container-driver-version=533.99
# after reboot verify pods come back and run a small allreduce smoke test
```

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-128 - "eu-west-2 H100 NCCL retries after driver 534.67". Paging oncall.

alex: We're also seeing scheduling delays — kubelet reports GPU driver taint while node is ready but can't accept pods until driver agent restarts. Could temporarily relax nodeSelector to fallback-hopper-compatible pods while we roll.

ravi: That fallback will increase burst cost (using older instance types) but acceptable for short window. Approve.

maria: Rolling now in eu-west-2a then 2b. Quick postmortem notes: root cause = stricter PTX/kernel signature checks in 534.67, our JIT/compilation path emits a PTX pattern that no longer matches the driver's expected signature for some SM90 kernels. Short-term: rollback drivers. Mid-term: recompile/update runtime kernel emitter + add PTX signature tests.

jeff: Please open a tracking ticket and add a canary test that validates kernel_signature across driver+ptx combos before driver rollouts.

maria: Created INF-4823 with logs, repro steps, and affected node list. cc: @ravi @alex. I'll update here as the rollback completes.
